gen-gf-battambang-gf-slabo-13px: Tall, tight, and a bit theatrical. Slabo 13px is the text serif underneath, with big open shapes in its a, e and s that make Battambang's compressed, curl-jawed forms look even more striking.
gen-gf-battambang-gf-suwannaphum: Quirky, narrow-shouldered letters take the lead in Battambang, every curve left gaping. Then Suwannaphum steps in, a serif with a tall, blocky lowercase, giving the whole thing a dignified editorial footing.
gen-gf-baumans-crimson-pro: Baumans draws each stroke with one constant thickness, its c flung open like a wrench. And Crimson Pro, a serif with fine hairlines and a gentle thick-thin cadence, brings a refined softness underneath.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-neco: Neco reads with a measured swell from hairline to stem, and its letters never pinch shut. Its dignity is the pair's strongest quality, set against Baumans, whose ribbon-flat strokes never vary in width.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-recia: Commanding, with a crescent-wrench c and one fixed nib width throughout Baumans. Big and short is where it earns its keep, while Recia, a text serif with barely visible modulation, stays generous and sharp beside it.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-alegreya: Alegreya brings literary warmth, with wide apertures. Baumans is best at bold, uniform strokes without any modulation, whereas Alegreya does its best work with joins that thin gently without turning spindly.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-alegreya-sc: Stern, uniform strokes up top, pulled like solder through a nozzle. Alegreya SC follows with a wide-open s and mild stress in its o and e, so give it the size you'd like to read comfortably.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-alike-angular: Authoritative describes both fonts, though they get there differently: Baumans uses ruler-drawn lines of constant width. But Alike Angular opens its letters and shows a restrained, visible gap between thick and thin.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-alyamama: That crescent-wrench c, cut by Baumans at a single depth with no heavier spots, is its calling card. Alyamama, a text serif, answers with softly dipping thin strokes, and the two feel formal yet gentle.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-ancizar-serif: Blunt, hard-edged strokes that are exactly as heavy in every bar as in every stem make Baumans stand out. Ancizar Serif, a text serif with sturdy hairlines, backs it up without a fuss.
